== Summary ==

Extracted unchanged from the original embedded JPEG on encyclopedia p. 43.<ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Source PDF SHA256: <code style="white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere">07bb3a1fbdd1a65f6cafdff1fca821108ff8210c82da70a10b988ea7539d1665</code>. Embedded image xref: 2051. Original image SHA256: <code style="white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere">6e912df05f089648dd383f95084352b35a65a7562232075446c0fd82a9fb7e6f</code>. No resize, crop, retouching or reconstruction.

The card credits Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998. This image documents the historical printing.
